Image5 is PRIMARY APPROVED ART STYLE only, rounded full-bodied clean Daoist chibi hand painting, soft dimensional volumes and restrained texture; no UI/text/characters. The top/left anchor strips embedded in Image1 come from frozen exact native neighbor crops.

Existing north-edge greenery, stair bottom and stone rail end are fixed. Complete only those objects whose visible parts already exist in the coarse layout and anchors. Do not add lanterns, trees, boxes, stalls, roads, stairs or decorations.
Where the coarse layout is blurred, resolve clean rounded material surfaces without changing occupied areas or object count. Match exact neighboring roof slope, eave termination, beams and paving directions. No new architectural footprint or altered road width. Keep the cropped nature of all edge objects. Single opaque1254x1254 square, full bleed, no border, words, guides, labels, grid or watermarks.
